# infrawrench_service (Data Source)

One service, looked up by `id` or `slug`, including services created in the app rather than by `infrawrench_service`.

Use it to refer to a service managed elsewhere, or to assert on one in a `precondition` (a tier-1 service must have an on-call schedule, say). Unlike the resource it also reads the resolved `member_count` and the owners' names and addresses, which change with the inventory and the member list rather than with the service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a service up by slug (or by id) to build on one managed elsewhere.
data "infrawrench_service" "checkout" {
  slug = "checkout-api"
}

# Fail the plan if a tier 1 service has nobody on call.
resource "terraform_data" "checkout_has_on_call" {
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.infrawrench_service.checkout.tier != 1 || data.infrawrench_service.checkout.on_call_schedule_id != null
      error_message = "Tier 1 services need an on-call schedule."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The service id. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The service's slug, e.g. `checkout-api`. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.

### Read-Only

- `budget_currency` (String) ISO 4217 code for `monthly_budget`; null without a budget.
- `description` (String) What the service is; null when unset.
- `links` (Attributes List) Dashboards, repositories and documents, in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))
- `member_count` (Number) Resources in the service right now: hand-picked members plus rule matches, minus exclusions.
- `monthly_budget` (Number) Monthly budget in `budget_currency`; null when unset.
- `name` (String) The service's name.
- `on_call_schedule_id` (String) The linked on-call schedule's id; null when none.
- `on_call_schedule_name` (String) The linked on-call schedule's name; null when none.
- `owner_team` (String) Free-text owning team; display only.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of String) Owning organization members' user ids.
- `owners` (Attributes List) The owning members with their current names and login addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `rules` (Attributes List) Membership rules, in the shape `infrawrench_service`'s `rule` blocks take. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `runbook_ids` (Set of String) Linked runbook ids.
- `slo_ids` (Set of String) Linked SLO ids.
- `tier` (Number) Criticality, 1 being the most critical; null for an untiered service.

<a id="nestedatt--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `links`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Link text.
- `url` (String) The URL.


<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Login address, when known.
- `name` (String) Display name, when the member has one.
- `user_id` (String) The member's user id.


<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The account the rule is narrowed to, if any.
- `key` (String) The tag or virtual tag key; null for `name` rules.
- `kind` (String) `tag`, `virtual_tag` or `name`.
- `name_match` (String) `name` rules: `contains`, `prefix`, `suffix` or `exact`.
- `plugin_id` (String) The provider the rule is narrowed to, if any.
- `value` (String) The value or name pattern; null for a `tag` rule matching any value.
